name: Driftwood
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
I owe you greatly, adventurer.  An honorable heart beats within you.  And now I have another task for which I humbly ask your aid.

If I'm ever to reach Nethergarde, then I must fix this wagon.  And for that... I will need wood.  Strong, dry wood--not the spongy, tangled wood of the swamp's trees.

adventurer, go east to the coast and search for driftwood that has been dried by the sun.  Bring it to me.
narrative.objectives: Bring 8 pieces of Sundried Driftwood to Watcher Biggs in the Swamp of Sorrows.
narrative.offerRewardText: This wood is light, but tough. Thank you, adventurer. It will work nicely.
narrative.requestItemsText: Did you find any driftwood, adventurer?

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 35 to 42, 11,600 XP in all.

quests.name: Encroaching Wildlife
quests.objectiveText: Kill 8 Young Sawtooth Crocolisks, 10 Sorrow Spinners and 10 Swamp Jaguars then return to Watcher Biggs in the Swamp of Sorrows.

quests.name: The Lost Caravan
quests.objectiveText: Find the Caravan Chest in the Fallow Sanctuary, obtain the Wizards' Reagents and bring to Watcher Biggs.

quests.name: Driftwood
quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 pieces of Sundried Driftwood to Watcher Biggs in the Swamp of Sorrows.

quests.name: Deliver the Shipment
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Shipment to Nethergarde to Quartermaster Lungertz in Nethergarde Keep.
